ModMetaData.name: IsoRim Waylith - Custom Quest Framework Pack
ModMetaData.author: Lin
ModMetaData.description:
Custom Quest Framework maps with IsoRimZ floors.
- A CQF map saved on a map with floors keeps them: walls, floors, roofs, stairs and everything upstairs - Its quest site comes out as it was made, in any game, whatever that game's floor count - Colonists walk in by the enter spot and up the stairs; enemies upstairs come down - Reopening a saved map in the CQF editor keeps its floors - Maps saved without floors behave as they do without this pack - CQF's chests, crates, stairs, cages and other furniture in 3D, opened states included
A map with floors can only be a quest site or a main map. As a pocket map, map part, settlement, outpost or scenario start it is refused with a short warning.
Needs IsoRimZ and Custom Quest Framework.
让 Custom Quest Framework 的地图用上 IsoRimZ 的楼层。
- 在有楼层的地图上保存的 CQF 地图会保留楼层：墙、楼板、屋顶、楼梯和楼上的一切 - 任务地点按原样生成，不受当前存档楼层数影响 - 小人从进入点进来、走楼梯上楼，楼上的敌人也会下楼 - 在 CQF 编辑器里重新打开已保存的地图，楼层不丢 - 没有楼层的地图和不装本包时完全一样 - CQF 的宝箱、木箱、楼梯、笼子等家具有 3D 模型，打开状态也是
有楼层的地图只能用作任务地点或主地图。用作子地图、地图片段、据点、前哨或开局地图时会被拒绝，并给出简短警告。
需要 IsoRimZ 和 Custom Quest Framework。
